dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent 'O' shaped structures exhibit irregular, fuzzy perimeters where a high-contrast gradient transitions from dark-intensity exterior pixels to light-intensity rings. The perimeter edges are dendritic and enclose dark interior cores, primarily located across the central horizontal axis.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid light-intensity clusters localized in the interstitial gaps between larger annuli, particularly in the lower-central region. Solid low-intensity (dark) pixel regions are concentrated on the far left of the frame, acting as a background void.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest central annuli form an irregular quadrilateral. An additional linear chain is formed by the centroids of three smaller light-intensity rings in the upper-right quadrant, oriented diagonally.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a flipper at the bottom-right corner featuring three distinct, low-intensity sharp points corresponding to claw structures protruding from the pelt.
